svg.title: EFI/ECU Integration — full wire-by-wire schematic
svg.desc: Complete point-to-point wiring schematic for the Holley Terminator X ECU, MSD 6EFI ignition, dual-sync distributor, sensors, and injectors, with every wire's color and gauge, laid out as a printable ladder diagram with a power distribution bus along the left margin.
svg.text: TERMINATOR X · MSD 6EFI (PN 6415) · DUAL-SYNC DISTRIBUTOR · PRINT AT 24×30 OR LARGER
Crossing lines w/o a dot = no connection
Bus taps below feed ECU, 6EFI, fuel pump
AVAILABLE / UNUSED ECU PINS — not wired in this build
CAN HI (A32, Orange/Black) / CAN LO (A24, Orange) — open for a future Holley dash or handheld
GAUGE OUTPUT (A15, White/Black) — unused, AutoMeter gauges use their own senders
PWM #1-4 (B12/B11/B10/B3, Grey/Yellow, Grey/Red, Grey/Black, Grey/Green) — possible future ECU-controlled fan
Electric Fan #1/#2 outputs — ground-switching, would need a relay if used (optional upgrade path)
EST1-8, EST GROUND OUT, EST 12V OUT (B14-B24) — distributorless-ignition pins, N/A for this single-distributor build
CRITICAL — never connect ANY EFI or tach wire to the coil terminals.
Only the 6EFI's Orange(+)/Black(-) may touch the coil (see COIL box, left column, below).
ECU's Coil(-) input (Yellow, A1) is NOT USED in this configuration — see dead-end marker below.
A23 5V ref / A26 signal / A18 ground
← via 10-pin ignition connector, also carries IPU
White points-trigger circuit: NOT USED (dual-sync only)
← Mag pickup Violet(+)/Green(−), from Distributor above
Orange(+)/Black(−) → COIL (below) — ONLY wires on coil
Cylinder select loops: UNCUT (8-cyl). Rev limiter set above 8,000 RPM.
Run-on diode included, not needed (internal-regulator alternator)
never a tach tap or ECU RPM wire
no adapter needed per MSD chart
A26 — Orange — signal A18 — Black/White — ground
MAT/IAT SENSOR — built into Holley 4150 throttle body
IAC STEPPER — 4-pin, built into throttle body
B1 A-Low — Purple/Blue B2 B-High — Purple/Yellow
B8 B-Low — Purple/White B9 A-High — Purple/Black
WBI_HTR / COMPR / VS / IP / SHIELD → A7/A8/A9/A16/A17/A25/A33/A34
Per-pin wire colors: verify against physical Holley harness at install —
not individually specified in source docs beyond pin function names above
Bung location: passenger-side header (confirmed by direct inspection)
Sensor bundled with Terminator X kit — bung weld pending exhaust build
B19 Grey → Inj A B26 White → Inj B B25 Beige → Inj C B13 Purple → Inj D
B4 Green → Inj E B5 Orange → Inj F B6 Blue → Inj G B7 Pink → Inj H
Sequential drivers, matches EV1 injector spec
Injector letter/cylinder mapping: confirm firing order during engine build
Red/Green, 14ga — relay 30/86 switched power, own dedicated fuse
CRITICAL — never connect ECU or tach wires to the coil terminals
Only 6EFI's Orange(+)/Black(−) may touch the coil. ECU's Coil(−) input (Yellow, A1) is NOT USED in this configuration.
Source: Chel Electrical Master Netlist — rows 86–135 (EFI/ECU section) · generated Aug 2026 · verify against physical harness before final crimp
